items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Bichet, that's the first time I heard Bichet play... Bichet was working for Clarence... I was on the wagon with them and Bichet was saying he bet he could learn how to play that thing

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Professor Minetta said he had played up there once.

Yeah, and Bichet, that's the first time I heard Bichet play, Bichet was working for Clarence. And then he had hired a woman to play piano for the show, her name was Emily, Emily Hines I think it was. She played piano for the show and he was the comedian on the show on the stage.
